newsitem.title: USA: Detroit Ed Fermi 2 nuke unit shut Saturday.
newsitem.headline: Detroit Ed Fermi 2 nuke unit shut Saturday.

text.p: Detroit Edison's 1,116 megawatt Fermi 2 nuclear power unit in Monroe County, Mich., was shut Saturday after beginning restart on Friday, the company said Monday.
"An indicator light in the control room is not working," company spokeswoman Mary Kay Bean said, noting the light indicates when the safety release valve is open.
She said she could not comment on when the unit would restart until plant operators found the cause of the faulty light.
A similar problem caused the unit to shut on December 2 while it was in restart mode following a scheduled 63-day maintenance and refueling outage, which began Sept 27.
Detroit Edison is a unit of DTE Energy Co.
